newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices gain on fresh interest.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices gain on fresh interest.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices gained to 1,151/1,152 rupees from 1,143/1,144 rupees on fresh interest on Monday, traders said.

"Increased export enquiries for castoroil as well as eased pressure of new crop arrivals at the producing centres triggered fresh bull support while bears were covering short positions," one trader said.

Groundnut oil rose from 344/345 rupees to 349/350 rupees per 10 kg on restricted arrivals of 60/70 tonnes coupled with renewed consumer support. In Rajkot spot oil rose by five rupees to 535 rupees per 15 kg.
